4.1. Recommendations for Practice
For practitioners seeking to implement a system in the spirit of this research, the
main recommendation is to invest in research on applications, not only in larger static
indicator lists but also in contextual enrichment, behavioral correlations across multiple
flows, and confidence-based scoring that replaces binary alerting with graded judgments.
Chief among these interventions is post-scoring allowlist suppression: in this study, a
curated allowlist applied after anomaly scoring was the single most decisive
improvement, raising detection within a ten-flow review budget from two of five families
to all five. Practitioners should adopt the same ordering, scoring every flow first and
suppressing known-benign traffic afterward, so that the allowlist can be audited for over-
